recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. The active CapabilityStatement XML already conveys the requested semantics; further edits would duplicate existing guidance or drift into later operation.name issues outside this seed decision.
issue_request: FHIR-13106 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2 conformance. It asked to copy Capability.rest.operation to Capability.rest.resource.operation, document when resource-level versus system/multi-resource operations should be listed, constrain those lists by OperationDefinition.type/instance/system/resource, and add operation documentation support.
initial_application: Commit 7360889bc386940c5ef3305ee7fafce957a08725 explicitly applied #13106 by adding CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.operation and changing CapabilityStatement.rest.operation to reuse that backbone. Commit 9e5e6b6148200ba40e05540d1e6f4aefcca3f6e5 later added CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.operation.documentation, completing the documentation portion now present in the current source.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes CapabilityStatement in the current FHIR build. Later Jira search hits such as FHIR-34234 and FHIR-36559 clarify CapabilityStatement operation.name behavior but do not supersede the FHIR-13106 resource-scoped operation model. Zulip and Confluence searches found no direct FHIR-13106 references or conflicting community record.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current source already defines CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.operation, its name/definition/documentation children, the comments requiring resource-level operations to use OperationDefinition.type or OperationDefinition.instance, rest.operation guidance for system or multi-resource operations, and the rule that listing an operation under multiple resources narrows server support to those resources.

related_jiras.note: Clarified intended use of CapabilityStatement operation.name but did not change the resource-scoped operation placement model.
Clarified CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.operation.name but did not change the FHIR-13106 resource operation model.
